transport.key_index: signed32 request0=session, anynonzero=generic; bind replies1/generic; status/cmd reply0/session regardless requestkey
transport.uid: Last numeric signed32 retained per device; nonnumeric keeps previous; native saves before validation but model commits only accepted requests after reply preflight.
transport.routing: Native status/bind require root inner.mac; cmd outertcid guard, ignores inner.mac. Model requires status/bind inner.mac and rejects conflicting inner identities for every operation; universally requires matching outertcid (explicit stricter chosen safety).
transport.limits: Original receive1024; AES/base64 scratch1024 including base64NUL; LF on outerJSON only. Strict JSON/padding, matching signed32 batch validation and atomic reply sizing are chosen safety rather than native unsafe tolerance.

simulation_policy.initial_cache: all16 numeric scratch slots0; not native physical startup
simulation_policy.gpio: Command request considered already active, retains uint16 Pow; timer action sets synthetic Pow0/1 and retains raw meter cache and state. No physical relay simulation.
simulation_policy.clock: Per-device first accepted status/cmd origin; monotonic whole seconds modulo32 for sourceclock; sample one tick per accepted request, no retroactive replay of missed seconds; RTC2026-01-01+elapsed seconds.
simulation_policy.readouts: Allzero shared int32[8] calendar backing and driver signal0, separately supplied internal readout inputs in tests. No ambient field or thermal model.
simulation_policy.reset: Electnumzero1 sets synthetic accumulation0, no flashIO. Countdown does not modify calendar windows.
simulation_policy.atomicity: No timer/cache/UID mutation until full batch/schema/reply scratch preflight succeeds. Native sequential partial mutations and faults not emulated.
